tips.newFileWhere: “New File” in the Explorer title bar

page.missing: This page is no longer available: the plugin that provided it has stopped

document.notText: {{name}} is not UTF-8 text (it may be a binary file or use another encoding) and cannot be opened here.
document.binary: {{name}} is a binary file and cannot be opened here.
document.editorGone: The editor for {{name}} is no longer available: the plugin that provided it has stopped or is not installed.

banner.conflict: The file changed on disk; the save was not written.
banner.diskChanged: The file changed on disk; saving will conflict.
banner.unresolved: Another view edited this document at the same time; this view's input has not been applied.
banner.unrepresentable: Block {{index}}{{excerpt}} in this view cannot be written back as Markdown; the input has not been applied and cannot be saved. Change the formatting of that block, or use the current text.
banner.deleted: The file was deleted. Saving recreates it at the same place.
banner.ended: The file service ended ({{reason}}); saving is not possible.
banner.saveUnknown: The save outcome is unknown; checking the disk.

closeDialog.title: Save changes to {{name}}?
closeDialog.body: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
closeDialog.bodyUnrepresentable: A block in this view cannot be written back as Markdown, so it cannot be saved; closing discards this view's changes.

enablePreview.title: Preview Tabs
enablePreview.description: A single click opens a replaceable tab that becomes permanent once edited or double-clicked

wrapTabs.title: Wrap Tabs
wrapTabs.description: Wrap tabs that do not fit; pinned tabs get a row of their own

breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.description: Show the file path and the current heading below the tabs

fontFamily.title: Font Family
fontFamily.description: A CSS font-family list; leave empty to use the theme's monospace font

lineHeight.title: Line Height
lineHeight.description: 0 follows the font size; below 8 multiplies the font size, 8 and above is in pixels

tabSize.title: Tab Size
tabSize.description: Spaces per indentation level; with indentation detection on, used only when nothing can be detected

detectIndentation.title: Detect Indentation
detectIndentation.description: Guess spaces or tabs and the indentation size from the file; when off, always use the tab size above with spaces

markdownToolbar.description: The toolbar above the Markdown editor
markdownToolbar.title: Editor Toolbar

reopenWith.title: Reopen Editor With
reopenWith.placeholder: Select an editor for this file

focused.reason: The editor does not have focus

lineNavigation.reason: The active editor cannot go to a line

dirty.reason: The active document has no unsaved changes

hasCursorPosition.reason: The active editor does not report a cursor position

ready.reason: The editor area is not ready yet

hasDocument.reason: The active editor has no text

hasEditorStatus.reason: The active editor reports no status

hasLanguage.reason: The active editor has no language mode

canConvertBlock.reason: The block type cannot be changed here

notice.lastEditMissing: The passage you last edited is no longer where it was: {{address}}
notice.unresolved: This view has unresolved input: first choose Use Current Text or Keep This View's Text at the top of the group
notice.unrepresentable: A block in this view cannot be written back as Markdown: first use Show Block at the top of the group and change it, or choose Use Current Text
notice.continueOutsideProject: Cannot open {{address}}: only files in the project can be opened to continue writing

refusal.currentUnresolved: The current view has unresolved input
refusal.currentUnrepresentable: A block in the current view cannot be written back as Markdown
refusal.targetUnresolved: The target group has unresolved input
refusal.targetUnrepresentable: A block in the target group cannot be written back as Markdown
refusal.unsavedBeforeBytes: There are unsaved changes: save or discard them before switching to an editor that shows bytes
refusal.noPreview: The active tab's file has no preview
refusal.notFileTab: The active tab is not a file tab
refusal.pageSplit: A page opens only once and cannot be split
refusal.pageEditor: A page is not a file, so its editor cannot be changed
refusal.noActiveFileTab: There is no active file tab
refusal.saveUnrepresentable: A view cannot be written back as Markdown, so nothing was saved: first use Show Block at the top of the group and change it, or choose Use Current Text
refusal.notReady: The editor is not ready yet
refusal.realPathFailed: Cannot get the absolute path of {{address}}: {{code}}
refusal.undoUnsupported: The current editor does not support undo
refusal.redoUnsupported: The current editor does not support redo
refusal.noPage: There is no page {{id}}, or the plugin that provides it is not ready yet
refusal.noPicker: There is no picker; give the {{arg}} argument
refusal.areaChanged: The editor area changed while picking
refusal.tabChanged: The active tab changed while picking
refusal.noLanguage: The active editor has no language mode
refusal.nothingToFocus: There is no editor to focus
refusal.targetChanged: The target editor was closed or switched
refusal.lineUnsupported: The active editor does not support line navigation
refusal.lineOutOfRangeOf: Line {{line}} is out of range ({{total}} lines)
refusal.editingUnsupported: The active editor does not support this action
